title: feat(sdk): add embeddings() method for /v1/embeddings
author: afanasevmylife
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Adds typed embeddings() methods to the SDK client and top-level API using the existing authentication, timeout, and error handling.
- Passes text, batches, and multimodal inputs to /v1/embeddings; preserves float or base64 responses and server-selected defaults.
- Adds a short usage example and focused coverage in the existing client tests. No backend changes or new dependencies.

## Verification
- SDK: 80 tests passed on rerun; the first run hit the pre-existing OAuth callback test flake.
- Typecheck, build, Biome, and built-SDK local HTTP smoke test passed.

Fixes #14366

gist.headline: Vectors join the hive
gist.blurb: The SDK can now turn text, batches, and multimodal inputs into embeddings without anyone having to hand-roll an HTTP request. Polli has put the vectors in neat little jars.
gist.summary: Added typed `embeddings()` methods to the Pollinations SDK client and top-level API, forwarding text, batch, and multimodal inputs to `/v1/embeddings` with existing auth, timeout, error handling, server defaults, and float or base64 response formats preserved.
gist.impact: JavaScript and TypeScript developers can now generate embeddings through the SDK's normal API surface instead of calling `/v1/embeddings` manually, including for batched and multimodal requests.
